**Audited brain v2.0.0 merge-readiness to main**

What: 6-axis parallel audit of feature/v2.0.0 to decide mergeability to main and usability by external consumers. Full report: ~/.claude/projects/-home-gandalf-IA-brain/design-docs/brain-v2-merge-audit.md
Why: user needs to know if v2 is mergeable and usable by other projects for their management.
Verdict: MERGEABLE — conditional. No deep code blocker. Core (VCS/memory ports, SDD artifact contract, exit-code contract, durable memory) is solid + heavily tested (~1.6x test-to-src).
Merge gates: G1 #210 release-gate runs after tag exists so cannot block (real bug); G2 #94 branch-protection tier decision (no rung-1 without it); G3 no ADR for AGENT_PLATFORM/SDD_ENGINE 3-axis split + README diverged; G4 trim resolvePlatform allow-list (openai/opencode/pi advertised but not implemented -> hard-fail); G5 close #217/#247/#222 (code merged, open only due to non-default-branch no-autoclose); G6 doc brain:review + context:compile + gitignore .memory/chunks.
Agent-roles answer (user's central question): brain does NOT define agent roles per SDD action like gentle-ai — BY DESIGN (ADR-0019). SDD_ENGINE routes only op 'init' (cli.mjs:99). Only 2 roles exist (executor doctrine, reviewer/refuter), neither bound to an SDD phase. All 8 SDD actions are role-less on brain's side. Strategic fork: brain stays role-agnostic (forces adopting gentle-ai, neutrality is theoretical) OR brain ships reference role layer / a real 2nd harness to prove n=2.
Memory NOT a blocker: cutover C0-C2b happened (PR #223-225, real run 275 written). #247 = scoped follow-up (engram sync still materializes .memory/chunks).
Provider parity gap: rung-2 release-gate + rung-3 postmerge auto-revert are GitHub-only; GitLab consumer gets weaker enforcement. 'provider-neutral governance' overclaimed.
Market: wins as system (governance-with-teeth moat), loses as product (distribution from private git tag, no MCP surface, weak onboarding DX/docs vs spec-kit/OpenSpec/Task Master/Kiro). Positioning reads as 3 stapled products; winning frame = governance-first.
Where: brain/scripts/harness/cli.mjs, brain/scripts/review/, brain/scripts/memory/backends/, .github/workflows/release.yml, adr-0019-harness-port.md, README.md.
